title: Vertiv reports strong orders, sales, and EPS growth; Raises full year guidance
summary: Vertiv delivered strong second quarter performance with net sales of $2,638 million, representing a 35% increase ($685 million) from the prior year period, driven by robust data center demand and continued market penetration.
